title: Successive clamped positions
statement: For every finite binary string $x$ and every offset $i\in\mathbb{N}$, moving right from the clamped input-head position for $i$ gives the clamped input-head position for $i+1$.
replaced:
Moving the input head right from the clamped offset $i$ yields the clamped offset
$i + 1$ — including repeated requests beyond the native right boundary, which
stay clamped.
